messages:
pagerduty-bot: SEV2 alert: prefix-cache hitrate drop in us-west-2. Paging @oncall.

samir: seeing it on the dashboard. hitrate for prefix /chat/v1 dropped from 98% -> 15% around 02:13 UTC.

samir: rolling 1-min heatmap: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/cache/hitrate?range=15m :eyes:

tayla: impact? customer-facing errors?

mohit: tailing prod logs — increased backend latency and 429s for some endpoints. Not widespread but heavy tail for customers using long prompt prefixes.

samir: logs (snippet):
```
2026-02-23T02:12:57Z INFO kv: cache_miss prefix=/chat/v1/prompt/42 shard=7 key_len=128
2026-02-23T02:12:57Z WARN runtime: fallback to model-variant-b (latency +120ms)
2026-02-23T02:13:01Z INFO kv: eviction triggered policy=prefix-invalidate job_id=inv-2026-02-23-0212
```

diane: that `prefix-invalidate` job is the nightly cleaner that ran at 02:12. we rolled a change last week to also consider user-id in key namespace, might be mis-scoped.

tayla: can we confirm if it removed common prefixes? query from analytics: `SELECT prefix, COUNT(*) FROM cache_evictions WHERE job_id='inv-2026-02-23-0212' GROUP BY prefix ORDER BY COUNT DESC LIMIT 10` returned top prefixes = `/chat/v1/prompt/` and some others.

mohit: i ran a quick grep on evictions: most evicted keys were short prefixes (length < 200) that's wrong; should have been long, expired sessions only.

samir: hypothesis A: invalidation job bug reusing a prefix-match that wasn't namespaced by user => mass eviction of hot shared prefixes.

diane: alternative hypothesis B: a KV shard remapping after last deploy caused wrong routing and so misses; cache client falls back and then eviction load snowballs.

sre-erin: ok mitigation: requeue a warmup job to repopulate top N prefixes. i can run warmers for top prefixes from the last 24h.

pagerduty-bot: On-call handoff: @mohit is now on-call for this thread. Please ack. :white_check_mark:

mohit: ack. i'll keep the handoff and drive mitigations.

mohit: immediate mitigation 1) disable prefix-invalidate job (paused) 2) spin up warmers for top 500 prefixes 3) increase cache TTL for shared prefixes to 12h temporarily.

samir: commands i ran:
```
# pause job
redwood infra jobs pause inv-2026-02-23-0212 --force
# start warmers
redwood cache warm --prefix-file /tmp/top_prefixes.txt --parallel 20
# bump TTL
redwood cache set-ttl --prefix "/chat/v1/prompt/" --ttl 12h
```

mohit: warmers started. traffic hitting warm nodes now. hitrate climbing: 15% -> 72% in 10m.

tayla: customer impact note: we saw increased 429/timeout for ~0.8% of requests in us-west-2 across 02:12-02:27 UTC. no data exfiltration. raising a status update draft for customers.

diane: collecting timeline: 
- 02:12 UTC: prefix-invalidate job runs (inv-2026-02-23-0212)
- 02:13 UTC: cache hitrate collapse observed
- 02:15 UTC: paging triggered
- 02:20 UTC: mitigation: job paused
- 02:25 UTC: warmers started
- 02:35 UTC: hitrate recovered to ~90%

sre-erin: i'm sharing logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/prod?from=02:10&to=02:40 filter=kv,eviction

samir: additional datapoint: evicted keys show pattern `/<service>/v1/prompt/` without per-uid suffix. matches hypothesis A.

mohit: i'm going to roll back the change that added `user-id` scoping to the invalidator — looks like the inverse bug where the scoping didn't get applied.

diane: can you link the PR? we need to trace which release included it.

mohit: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/commit/af3bd9d — deploy timestamp 2026-02-16 05:03 UTC

tayla: check deploy logs around that time — any job config migrations? 

samir: found a config template change: `{{#if enable_user_scoping}}ns={{user_id}}{{/if}}` replaced with `ns={{user_id}}` accidentally in template -> null or empty user_id evaluated to empty string for system jobs causing global namespace.

mohit: confirmed. root cause pinned: template change removed conditional, meaning when user_id absent the template emitted empty ns -> matches all prefixes -> mass invalidation.

sre-erin: actions to track:
- revert template change (PR ready)
- add unit/integration test for template to ensure empty user_id doesn't produce global namespace
- add alarm on prefix-invalidate job that flags >5% eviction of top 100 prefixes
- improve warmup auto-trigger when hitrate drops >20% for 5m

tayla: i'm drafting post-incident customer update noting brief elevated errors and our steps. tagging support & comms.

mohit: PR created to revert: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/PR/4721

samir: after revert and warmers, hitrate stable at 95%. monitoring for 2h.

diane: assigning owners for RCA write-up: mohIT (code root cause), samir (metrics/timeline), tayla (customer comms). target RCA doc by EOD tomorrow.

mohit: quick notes for RCA: root cause = template regression that removed conditional scoping; causal chain = bad template -> job emitted global namespace -> mass evictions -> client fallbacks & latency -> customer impact.

sre-erin: adding long-term prevention items to backlog. :memo:

mohit: closing incident thread when RCA published. thanks everyone — great triage.
